_doc: Presentation tunables only (no rule numbers). Sizes are canvas units, about 1 dp on phones and tablets (scripts/platform/display_scale.gd). auction_quick_bid_steps: raise amounts shown as buttons in the auction panel; the minimum legal bid always comes from rules.json. board_max_share_*: largest share of the screen's long side the board may take while the Dig 5a1 interim control column shows (forced auction / debt / trade input, or Action), so the column keeps room; board-first play gives the board the full short side. trade_cash_steps: +/- buttons beside the trade cash fields. bot_step_seconds: pause between bot actions so people can follow. setup_*: seat setup screen (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q19): seat counts offered, the minimum number of people needed to start, and each seat's Human/Bot default (true = bot).
theme_path_doc: visual theme pack (colors, StyleBoxes, board chrome); see docs/THEME_MAP.md
motion_doc: P4-DEMO motion and dialogue timings (seconds; TODO tune on device, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q21). dice_roll_seconds: dice tumble before the faces settle. pawn_step_seconds: one hop per space; pawn_move_max_seconds caps a long move (card advances) by speeding hops up. pawn_jump_seconds: straight arc to the Brig. pawn_hop_height: hop lift as a share of a board cell. banner_seconds: how long a line stays when nothing waits; banner_backlog_seconds when more lines wait; banner_max_queue: waiting lines kept (oldest dropped). bot_wait_banner_queue: bots pause while more than this many lines wait. panel_fade_seconds: auction / debt / trade / section fades; screen_fade_seconds: setup and match screens; pulse_seconds: turn-label and banner flash.
bot_auction_step_seconds_doc: pause between bot auction bids (bots raise in $1 steps, so auctions need a quicker pace)
setup_min_humans_TODO: at least one person by default; all-bot matches stay possible in GameSetup for headless soak (docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md Q19)
turn_panel_doc: P5-FEEL Dig 5 turn panel (OPEN_QUESTIONS Q23): floats in the free band after the board, else over the board center clear of the dialogue banner; the board never resizes for it. Canvas units: width at most turn_panel_max_width and at least turn_panel_min_width; buttons sit in two columns from turn_panel_two_column_width.
